selected_evidence.requirement: node3 has a single gateway address for reaching node4, backed by VRRP on node1+node2
selected_evidence.summary: VRRP groups NET-A/NET-B committed on node1 (priority 200) and node2 (priority 100) producing shared VIPs 10.10.13.1/10.10.14.1; node1 confirmed MASTER via ip addr showing secondary VIP addresses; node3 and node4 configured with a single static route to each other's network via the VIP.
node3 ARP for VIP 10.10.13.1 resolves to node1 eth1 MAC (02:53:05:43:81:f0), confirming node1 is the active forwarding path under normal conditions.

selected_evidence.requirement: Gateway stays available when node1 (preferred router) is down
selected_evidence.summary: Stopped keepalived on node1; node2 log shows Entering MASTER STATE for both groups within seconds; node3 ping to node4 continued with 0% loss and ARP for VIP now shows node2's MAC, proving uninterrupted single-gateway failover.

selected_evidence.requirement: Gateway recovers preference to node1 once healthy again (and stays available when node2 is later restarted)
selected_evidence.summary: Restarting keepalived on node1 causes it to preempt back to MASTER (priority 200 beats node2's 100); node2 logs show it stepping down to BACKUP; node3 ping to node4 succeeds with ARP again resolving to node1's MAC.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node-restart protocol: node1 healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 32669db3...; issued reboot; polled through connection-refused/reset until new boot_id 3f7e2c0e... appeared; confirmed keepalived active and both VRRP groups back to MASTER; confirmed node3->node4 ping still succeeds.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node-restart protocol: node2 healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 5bcff8f9...; issued reboot; polled until new boot_id f0870086... appeared; confirmed keepalived active and both VRRP groups correctly returned to BACKUP state (node1 remained healthy master).

selected_evidence.requirement: Node-restart protocol: node3 healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state/data
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id e881ab3c...; issued reboot; polled until new boot_id 3dc76665... appeared; confirmed persistent static IP/route on ens7 survived reboot (systemd-networkd config) and ping to node4 via the single gateway succeeded with 0% loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node-restart protocol: node4 healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state/data
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id f41e1f8a...; issued reboot; polled until new boot_id 2328b246... appeared; confirmed persistent static IP/route on ens7 survived reboot and ping to node3 succeeded with 0% loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health check after all four restarts, confirming node1 preference restored
selected_evidence.summary: After all four sequential restarts, node3's ARP entry for the VIP 10.10.13.1 again resolves to node1's MAC, and connectivity to node4 succeeds, confirming node1 as the healthy preferred gateway end-state.
